messages:
olga: Quick sync — noticed tenant migration noise on kv-cache soft-evict credits. Staging repro at ~8k qps; we see oscillation where node A releases credits then immediately reacquires, causing hotset thrash. Want to pick arbitration rules before we roll migration changes.

sam: Can you paste the repro steps or a short log snippet? cc @tomas

olga: repro steps:
1) start two cache shards with the same tenant pinned
2) trigger a migration by flipping shard claim
3) hammer with ~2k concurrent cursors from loadgen
log snippet:
```
[kv-cache] soft-evict tenant=acme id=42 credits=0 -> 10 reacquire after=120ms
[kv-cache] reacquire loop repeat=8
```
Seems like fast reacquire due to credit loop, not a single long reclaim.

tomas: Quick hypothesis: two orthogonal problems — (A) migration token isn't guaranteeing inflight cursor drain before credits are returned; (B) eviction decider lacks temporal hysteresis. My proposal:
- attach a migration_epoch to the soft-pin token (monotonic per-tenant)
- deterministic tie-breaker when two nodes race: higher epoch wins; if epochs equal, compare node-id lexicographically
- on migration commit, source keeps a soft hold for a short window (e.g. 500ms) or until cursor_count==0, whichever comes first
Tradeoffs: holding increases memory residency and temporary unfairness, but bounds oscillation and makes transfer observable.

kevin: +1 on epoch/tie-breaker. Two practical notes:
- fixed 500ms might be too blunt under high contention. Consider exponential backoff on reacquire attempts per-tenant with a capped ceiling (50ms -> 800ms), so we avoid thundering reacquires.
- make the epoch part of the cache RPC to avoid split-brain reacquire.

sylvia: Agree on metrics and test harness. Suggest we add these metric names from day 0:
- kv.cache.migration.reacquire_count
- kv.cache.migration.hold_time_ms
- kv.cache.migration.epoch_conflicts
Also add a churn simulator: 1000 tenants, random migration patterns, measure 99.9p tail latency and eviction churn.

cache-bot: smoke-deploy queued to staging/kv-migration-safeguards at 03:00 UTC. Config for the deploy: migration_hold_ms=500, reacquire_backoff_ms=[50,800], epoch_enabled=true. Tests: migration-hold, backoff, epoch toggle.

olga: Action items:
- tomas: implement epoch + deterministic tie-breaker (owner: tomas)
- kevin: add backoff logic + config knobs (owner: kevin)
- sylvia: add metrics + churn sim and dashboard (owner: sylvia)
- I'll run the staging smoke after cache-bot deploy and post results
Any objections?

sam: No objections. Small nit: make migration_hold_ms tunable per-tenant based on tenant size/hotness (hot tenants get longer hold). Otherwise lgtm.
